title: Drainage Response-Law Family and Sensitivity Qualification

qualified_findings.DRAMET1: piecewise-linear abs(gwl) response with explicit knot and possible gwl=0 nonsmoothness
qualified_findings.DRAMET2: analytic stable-branch dq/dgwl verified against finite difference for IPOS 1..5
qualified_findings.DRAMET2_IPOS4: vertical-resistance derivative changes at the layer interface when kvtop differs from kvbot
qualified_findings.DRAMET2_small_cutoff: legacy 1e-10 branch exists but exact equality reconstructed from head/shape is floating-representation-sensitive
qualified_findings.DRAMET2_parameter_domain: legacy input ranges are wider than the mathematically valid domain of formulas using division and logarithms
qualified_findings.DRAMET3_interflow: for legacy-admitted exponent below one, the right-hand activation tangent diverges
qualified_findings.DRAMET3_multilevel: stable-branch total derivative is the sum of per-level derivatives; nonsmooth points compose as the union of level branch points
